channel.title: Santa Cruz Sentinel - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Santa Cruz Sentinel (santacruzsentinel.com)

item.title: Watsonville seeks input on art designs for City Plaza stage
item.description: The city has received four designs from different local artists and is asking the community to give their thoughts on all of them, in both an online survey and an in-person forum Feb. 24.

item.title: Kurtenbach: Does SF Giants manager Tony Vitello actually want to be here?
item.description: The Giants manager's strange Monday presser opened up big questions that shouldn't be asked in spring training.

item.title: Suspect in custody after shooting along San Lorenzo River in Santa Cruz
item.description: The victim of a shooting that occurred along the San Lorenzo river last week is expected to survive and the alleged gunman was taken into custody, according to the Santa Cruz Police Department.

item.title: Santa Cruz native and son of well-known surfing family Kurt Van Dyke reportedly killed in Costa Rica
item.description: "He was a class act," said one longtime friend of Van Dyke's. "Just someone who you'd want to hang out with ... was passionate about surfing; passionate about life."

item.title: Opening statements held in the trial of a Georgia high school shooting suspect’s father
item.description: Prosecutors say he gave his son access to a gun and ammunition despite warning signs.

item.title: First of three rainstorms brings Bay Area a ‘solid soaking,’ minor flooding
item.description: In a statement, Santa Cruz County officials said that the Office of Response, Recovery and Resilience is monitoring local rivers and streams but waterways including the San Lorenzo River are forecast to remain below flood levels.

item.title: Trump administration ordered to restore George Washington slavery exhibit it removed in Philadelphia
item.description: The order came on Presidents Day, the federal holiday honoring Washington’s legacy.

item.title: Cuban drivers face monthslong wait for gasoline in a government app designed to reduce lines
item.description: Fuels shortages and blackouts have been intensifying in Cuba this month.

item.title: Photos | Skateboarder uses umbrella to stay dry as rain falls in Santa Cruz
item.description: The National Weather Service forecast for Santa Cruz County calls for rain — on and off — through the weekend with possible thunderstorms on Tuesday.

item.title: Guest Commentary | Build interim trail down to Watsonville
item.description: "Let’s build the interim trail all the way to Watsonville," writes Robert Stephens in a Guest Commentary. "It is time for South County to receive its share of the trail, instead of relying on dangerous bike lanes on San Andreas Road and Beach Street."
